Tethera 1.0.1 fixes switching between sessions.

Update with Tethera → Check for Updates…, `brew upgrade --cask tethera`, or `curl -fsSL https://tsogbat.github.io/tethera/install.sh | bash`. Your sessions keep running.

### Fixes
- Clicking a session in the sidebar switches at once. Every click used to wait out the double-click interval (about 0.4 s) in case it was a rename.
- After switching sessions, what you type goes to the terminal. A switch could leave the keyboard with nothing: the cursor turned into a hollow box and keys did nothing until you clicked into the terminal.
- Clicking empty space in the sidebar no longer takes the keyboard away from the terminal.
- Finishing or cancelling a rename (Return or Escape) puts you back in the terminal.
